arguments.question: food grade certificate supplier food contact gasket
What are the limits for direct purchase orders versus raising a purchase request?

content: No, we cannot. Under Purchase Policy §6.2 (POL-PUR-001 §6.2) and Supplier Policy §4.1 (POL-SUP-003 §4.1), parts that come into contact with food—including gaskets (GSK-SIL-05L)—may only be bought from suppliers holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. Even if their price is lower, Bahi will not allow an order to be placed without a valid certificate uploaded and verified first.
